scope: Bounded read-only retention policy and legal-hold CLI inventories plus database-free command help; mock-backed, no live database or provider access
checks: Policy inventory validates status, location UUID, jurisdiction and purpose codes, and row limit before opening a cursor
Policy inventory returns only bounded configuration and approval fields, excluding free-text metadata and audit reasons
Legal-hold inventory defaults to active records, supports a bounded released-history view and exact-entity filters, and excludes hold reasons
CLI argument wiring preserves bounded filters and active-only hold defaults
Declarative CLI help parses without loading database secrets; database connection creation remains lazy until a database command runs
limitations: No live database, candidate, legacy stack, or provider was contacted
CLI actors remain attribution only; these commands are not authenticated or exposed through the Gateway
No retention period, policy, legal hold, archive workflow, or cleanup schedule was configured or enabled
Jurisdiction-owned retention, notification archive/deletion, and MAN-CAP-047/051 acceptance remain open
